faqs.question: Can GrowQR help me get a job?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowQR matches you to relevant roles and can auto apply on higher plans, builds an ATS ready resume, and prepares you with mock interviews. Your RQ Score shows how ready you are before you apply. Start free at growqr.ai

faqs.question: Can GrowQR help me upskill?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowQR identifies the skill gaps for your target role and curates courses to close them. Progress feeds into your RQ Score. Free includes one lesson. Paid plans add course access, assessments, and certification: growqr.ai

faqs.question: Do you have plans for teams or enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowQR Business offers AI agents for hiring, employee development, and workforce analytics, with pricing tailored to your team. Tell me your team size and goal and I can connect you with our team.

faqs.question: Do you offer a demo?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowQR offers demos for recruiters, universities, and companies. Share your name, work email, and organisation, and I can connect you with our team to arrange one.

faqs.question: How can I contact GrowQR support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us right here in chat. Say talk to our team and I will connect you during business hours (IST), or take your details for a follow up if we are offline. You can also use the contact form at growqr.ai/contact or email support@growqr.ai.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription or request a refund?
faqs.answer: You can cancel anytime in your account settings or by emailing support@growqr.ai. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Refund requests must be made within 30 days of the charge. Full policy: growqr.ai/refund-policy

faqs.question: Is GrowQR available in my country?
faqs.answer: Availability depends on your region. Where GrowQR is live, you can sign up and see plan pricing at growqr.ai. Where it is not yet available, plans show as Coming soon with the option to join the waitlist on the same page. For confirmation on a specific country, I can connect you with our team.

faqs.question: Is my data used to train AI models?
faqs.answer: No. Your personal data is never used to train AI models. GrowQR stores only the minimum information needed and uses enterprise grade infrastructure with AWS and Cloudflare. Full policy: growqr.ai/privacy-policy

faqs.question: What can GrowQR AI help me with?
faqs.answer: I can help with plans and pricing, the AI agents, your RQ Score, resume and interview prep, career guidance, and getting your team a demo. Tell me what you are working on and I will point you to the right place.

faqs.question: What is GrowQR?
faqs.answer: GrowQR is an AI powered career platform. It gives you specialised AI agents for resumes, interviews, skill building, learning, branding, and job matching, plus an RQ Score that shows how ready you are and what to improve next. You can start free at growqr.ai.

faqs.question: What is RQ Score?
faqs.answer: RQ Score, or Readiness Quotient, measures how prepared you are for your next career move. It looks at your skills, profile, experience, and overall readiness, then shows where you stand and what to improve next. Every plan includes RQ Score reports, and the Free plan includes one free profile report.
